source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Allowing the pin sites to remain completely untouched and uncleaned for an indefinite period of time following the initial placement","B":"Fairly little specific care actually being needed for the pin sites of an external fixator device once it has been placed","C":"Care essentially identical to routine skin care performed elsewhere on the body, without any special attention paid to the pin sites themselves","D":"Regular pin site cleaning per facility protocol and monitoring for signs of infection, given the direct communication between the pin and underlying bone"}}
source_row.rationale: External fixator pin site care typically includes regular cleaning per facility protocol and ongoing monitoring for signs of infection, given the direct communication between the pin and underlying bone, which creates a pathway for potential infection if not properly cared for.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Regular Pin Site Care
source_row.source_name: Standard Orthopedic Nursing References — External Fixator Pin Care
